{"parse":{"title":"Quantum vault","pageid":275,"redirects":[],"text":"

Each vaulted asset has a 50% chance of being kept during reincorporation. You can install quantum stabilization to increase the chance to 75%.

When you have not built a space station, it shows "You need to build a space station in $$orbit to access your quantum vault." when you do $$vault.

You can use $$vaultall and $$vaultremove to add and remove assets on quantum vault.
